title: StartServiceRequest
description: Sent by the server to a station to start a service on a specific bay.

sessionId.description: Unique identifier for this service session.

bayId.description: Identifier of the bay where the service will run.

serviceId.description: Identifier of the CATALOG SERVICE to start — the commercial offering the customer paid for, minted by the server. Not the station's physical program: that is programNumber, which names the operation the bay physically runs. One program MAY carry several services (the same hardware sold at a promotional rate and a standard rate), so the two are not interchangeable, and the receipt names the serviceId — never the program — so the price actually paid stays identifiable.

programNumber.description: The ordinal of the PHYSICAL PROGRAM to run on the target bay, as the station declared it at provisioning. Carried explicitly so the station acts on a field rather than indexing its own catalog by serviceId, and so a service minted since the last catalog push still starts. The station MUST verify the ordinal was declared for that bay and, if it was not, MUST reject with 3017 PROGRAM_NOT_DECLARED — never accept and do nothing, which is a customer who paid and got no wash. ROLLOUT: the SERVER originates this message, so the station is the receiver and must accept the field before a server emits it. A server also cannot supply the value until an operator has created the service->program binding for each station, which is human work between the deploy and the enforcement and belongs in the plan explicitly. See VERSIONING.md, 'Adding a REQUIRED field, and which side moves first'.

durationSeconds.description: Authorized duration of the service in seconds.

reservationId.description: Associated reservation identifier, if the bay was pre-reserved.
